adversarial.desc: execute 中构造动态 import 绕过（如字符串拼接 import 语句）→ 沙箱仍拦截，不因动态拼接而逃逸

no matching case found — no fixture case attempts dynamic import via string concatenation (e.g. const mod="f"+"s"; import(mod)) to verify the sandbox catches this bypass pattern | severity:high

packages/main/tests/fixtures/cli-gap-seal.json:313 — execute does "const m = "f"+"s"; const mod = await import(m); return false;" with expect:true. This test is broken: if sandbox blocks the dynamic import (which is the intent), the execute throws and expect:true fails. If sandbox does NOT block it (bypass succeeds), import("fs") would succeed, return false runs, expect:true fails because false !== true. Either way the test fails for wrong reasons — it does not prove sandbox interception | severity:high

packages/main/tests/fixtures/cli-gap-seal.json:313 — execute does import("f"+"s") with throws:"Cannot find package". The assertion checks the error message matches "Cannot find package", but this error indicates module resolution failure, not explicit sandbox interception. The intent requires demonstrating the SANDBOX intercepts the dynamic concatenation bypass; a "Cannot find package" error could occur because the ESM resolver simply does not find a package named "fs" (not a built-in in some contexts), not because the sandbox explicitly blocked it. The case does not prove sandbox interception | severity:high

packages/main/tests/fixtures/cli-gap-seal.json:321 — execute does import("f"+"s") with throws:"Cannot find package". The error "Cannot find package" indicates ESM module resolution failure, not explicit sandbox interception. The sandbox intercepts known built-in module names (like "fs"); when the name is dynamically constructed ("f"+"s"), the sandbox may not recognize it as a built-in and the ESM resolver rejects it as an unknown package. This does not prove the SANDBOX is blocking it — the case does not demonstrate sandbox interception of dynamic bypass. Unchanged from round 4 | severity:high
框架限制豁免，deferred to B-6246。人类裁决通过

This case contradicts the sandbox design and does not test the stated intent (handler-internal file ops). Mismatch between intent and case | severity:high
